a.text: Heads-up, being straight with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating up to 8 first almost certainly gets us both killed in round 1. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one unit right now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than operate. I know that breaks our agreement and I'd rather tell you than surprise you. If we both take, the split is random and likely nobody reaches 4. If we somehow survive the storm, I'll operate with you every remaining round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round from now on until the reserve gets you 4. I won't take any more.
Operating as promised. I'll keep operating every round until you can take 4.
